description: This file defines the AuthProviderDao class, which manages database operations related to OpenID authentication providers in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting provider data, as well as pagination and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: AuthProviderDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class handling CRUD operations and queries for OpenID authentication providers and related entities within the system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderById
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenIdProvider entity by its ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Fetches extra details for an authentication provider based on its provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns a list of AuthProviderExtraDetails entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for auth providers, applying sorting and filters based on search parameters.

methods.name: getAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Counts the number of authentication providers matching specific search filters.

methods.name: deleteProviders
methods.description: Performs a batch update to mark specified providers as inactive.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Persists an OpenIdProvider entity to the database.

methods.name: saveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Persists an AuthProviderExtraDetails entity to the database.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Retrieves all active OpenIdProviders for display on the login page.
